Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 02/01/2012. IM 6434
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error_dist('0331');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;
-- End of change

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 temp_number number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id is null
 then
 begin
 --
 select max_number+1 into temp_number
 from number_generation
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and number_type = 'CUSTOMER_ID'
 for update of max_number;
 --
 
 select nvl(max(to_number(substr(customer_id,7,4))),0)+1
 into :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 from customers
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and customer_type = :customer_type;
 ----PR# 001000282--------------------
 Loop
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x FROM customers
 WHERE customer_id = 
 substr(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,1,3)||'-'||:customer_type||
 lpad(:ctrl_blk_1.customer_id,4,'0')
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id := to_number(:ctrl_blk_1.customer_id) + 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 exit;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 End loop; 
 -----Problem - If the last ID of a type is edited and the type
 -----of customer is changed then next time it gives unique
 -----index violation.
 -----Handled in the above manner so as not to limit the number
 -----of customers to just 9999.
 --
 update number_generation
 set max_number = temp_number
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and number_type = 'CUSTOMER_ID';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in generating new customer ID');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id := substr(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,1,3)||
 '-'||:customer_type||
 lpad(:ctrl_blk_1.customer_id,4,'0');
 end if;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date:= v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if; 
 :valid_customer.customer_id := :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id;
 :last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 :valid_customer.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 message('Msg: Please note the new ID');
 pause;
end;
